aggressive_definition: Fatal prostate cancer and advanced-stage prostate cancer at diagnosis; high-grade disease was separately defined as Gleason score at least 7 or at least 8.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: In relation to these risk factors, advanced stage at diagnosis was a good surrogate for fatal prostate cancer, but high-grade (Gleason >/= 7 or Gleason >/= 8) was not.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis of the Health Professionals Follow-Up Study using multivariable Cox regression
reason: The abstract explicitly analyzes overall incident prostate cancer and aggressive incident outcomes, including fatal prostate cancer and advanced stage at diagnosis. Its discussion of predictors of advanced cancer among men already diagnosed with low-grade cancer represents progression and is not independently treated as incident aggressive disease.
